paragraphs: I'm applying for the Financial Analyst, G&A role. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I spent about five and a half years at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. I'm interested in the finance side of AI companies, and owning the G&A budget across Finance, Legal, People and Corporate Affairs at a company training frontier models is a good place to learn how that spend scales.

At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and ran variance and sensitivity analyses on budget reallocation that I turned into recommendations for stakeholders. At Thomson Reuters I worked with finance teams on monthly P&L forecasting, variance analysis and closing activities for the ANZ region.
That maps to building department budgets and forecasts, explaining variances to budget owners, and keeping the workforce model current. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
